## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +10.10%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +8.16%), COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.66% | 1M: +13.79%). Materials strength: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +24.37%). Industrials showing pickup: UBER ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +4.55%). **3. Which sectors are lagging?**

Financials marginally negative: Financials negative on 1W (see sector summary). Sector Breadth: Consumer Stpl., Consumer Disc., Financials, Real Estate are lagging.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**

Weakness concentrated in Consumer staples/discretionary names and select large caps.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Big 1W movers: XOM (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +10.10%) and CVX (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +8.16%) showing strong 1W and 1M confirmation ABOVE TREND; MSFT (1W: +1.02% | 1M: +27.93%) and NVDA (1W: +2.22% | 1M: +5.80%) retain momentum. Major divergence alert: AMZN CORRECTION (1W: -1.97% | 1M: +8.00%) and TSLA RECOVERY (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -17.33%) show mixed shorter-term signals — tactical watch.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

Mixed; several megacaps under pressure while AI names hold up. NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.22% | 1M: +5.80%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.02% | 1M: +27.93%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.73% | 1M: -3.92%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -4.44%). Sector Breadth: Technology positive (listed as +2.28% 1W across 24 stocks).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Mixed-to-soft in the near term. JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +6.50%), V TREND EXHAUSTION → CORRECTION (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +1.14%), AIG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.97% | 1M: -3.62%). Sector Breadth: Financials showing internal strain (sector 1W: -0.10% across 20 stocks).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Patchy but several leaders. LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.31% | 1M: +5.88%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.94% | 1M: +10.39%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -1.73% | 1M: -4.61%), ISRG ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +5.74%). Sector Breadth: Healthcare positive (1W: +2.28% across 17 stocks).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to cyclical/value areas led by Energy and Materials (XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +10.10%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +24.37%)); reduce exposure to megacap names showing confirmed weakness (AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.73% | 1M: -3.92%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -4.44%)). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt but maintain hedges given major-cap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +10.10%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +8.16%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.22% | 1M: +5.80%). BEARISH: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.73% | 1M: -3.92%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -4.44%), MNST BELOW TREND (1W: -51.18% | 1M: -52.63%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA above recent pivot; watch 1M consolidation for continuation (NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.22% | 1M: +5.80%)). AAPL support test to monitor downside (AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.73% | 1M: -3.92%)). XOM break/hold of the 1W strength will confirm energy leadership (XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +10.10%)).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**

AAPL (-45): AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.73% | 1M: -3.92%) — negative commentary and price weakness confirm distribution. ## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt. XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +10.10%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +8.16%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.02% | 1M: +27.93%) are showing relative strength. Key risk: pronounced megacap divergence (AAPL, GOOGL, META BELOW TREND) and mixed news signals (LLY/ HON) — watch for trend confirmation.
